$chatId..write:
auth != null
          && !data.exists()
          && newData.child('createdBy').val() === auth.uid
          && newData.child('members').child(auth.uid).val() === true
          && newData.child('isDefaultAgentGroup').val() !== true
          && (
            (
              newData.child('isSupportChat').val() === true
              && newData.child('isGroup').val() === true
              && $chatId === ('support_' + auth.uid)
              && newData.child('members').child('support-ai').val() === true
            )
            || (
              newData.child('isSupportChat').val() !== true
              && (
                (newData.child('isGroup').val() === false
                  && newData.child('dmKey').val() === $chatId)
                || newData.child('isGroup').val() === true
              )
            )
          )

$messageId..write:
auth != null
            && root.child('chats').child($chatId).child('members').child(auth.uid).val() === true
            && !data.exists()
            && (
              newData.child('senderId').val() === auth.uid
              || (
                root.child('chats').child($chatId).child('isSupportChat').val() === true
                && newData.child('senderId').val() === 'support-ai'
                && newData.child('isAi').val() === true
              )
            )

$uid..write:
auth != null
                && auth.uid === $uid
                && root.child('chats').child($chatId).child('members').child(auth.uid).val() === true
                && root.child('chats').child($chatId).child('isSupportChat').val() !== true
                && (!newData.exists() || newData.isString())

$chatId..write:
auth != null && (
            auth.uid === $uid
            || root.child('chats').child($chatId).child('members').child(auth.uid).val() === true
            || (
              !root.child('chats').child($chatId).exists()
              && newData.parent().parent().parent().child('chats').child($chatId).child('members').child(auth.uid).val() === true
              && newData.parent().parent().parent().child('chats').child($chatId).child('createdBy').val() === auth.uid
            )
          )
